statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service is to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
The diagnoses addressed are I48.0 and I49.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before the service was rendered
